Basically Gridcoin is a cryptocurrency like Bitcoin, but instead of solving useless hashes to mine Bitcoins, you have to run scientific simulations to solve (cancer), make new renewable energy solutions or create AI.

Bitcoin is a great idea that has enormous potential as the currency of the future, but the mining is wasteful and useless as ensuring the security of the network can be done with a lot less waste of energy and the competitive element of who earns newly created coins can be done with a competition who gives most computing power to science.

The whole system is decentralized, the only centralized part is a whitelist that has the information which BOINC projects should be rewarded, that is currently curated by an administrator, but this will soon be replaced by incoin-voting, so that the community determines which projects are supported.

This is proof of all the work that has already been done by our miners: http://boincstats.com/en/stats/-1/team/detail/118094994/overview[5]

Tutorial to get started: http://wiki.gridcoin.us/Mining_setup[6]

More information: https://cryptocointalk.com/topic/31900-anngrc-gridcoin-research-a-secure-blockchain-developed-on-the-philosophy-of-benefiting-humanity/[7]
